description: He spends $35K a day on Meta ads — and this is his #1 creative tip 👀 I asked this guy how much he spends on Meta ads. He said: “About $35,000 a day.” 💰 Then he gave one of the best reminders in advertising: “Creative isn’t a checklist item. Ask yourself — will this stop the scroll?” It’s easy to get lost in bids, budgets, and targeting… but none of that matters if your creative doesn’t grab attention. The creative is the ad. It’s the only thing the user ever actually sees. Would your ads perform better if you made creatives that truly stop the scroll? 👇 Comment “SCALE” if you want to apply to work with me 1:1 and learn how to build ad systems that actually scale. 🚀
